what_happened.line: The Capital Planning Committee heard the facilities director present the school department's FY22 capital requests and a ten-year plan; no votes were taken.
Requests included primary school air conditioning, Turkey Hill administration cooling and Turkey Hill exterior envelope repairs; the primary school estimate may fall once design is done.
The Turkey Hill cooling request comes off FY22 if it is funded at the November special town meeting.
A public commenter asked why a change to the minimum dollar threshold for capital projects was not on the agenda; the committee will set an active date when it meets the selectmen.
The next meeting was set for the 24th at 5:15, with fire and police invited and the DPW director the meeting after.

why_it_matters: School cooling and building repair requests feed the capital plan that Town Meeting is asked to fund, so they can affect future borrowing and the tax bill.
The unresolved minimum dollar threshold decides which projects go through capital planning, so smaller 2022 requests could be treated differently depending on where it is set.
